description:
FILED s466bd (Opus, 2026-09-03), found by a #995 probe
(scratch/p995/16b-hash-of-hash-loop.pl).  PRE-EXISTING: every row below is
identical on a 57848f3 worktree, and the minimal rows use LITERAL keys, so no
boxing verdict is involved at all.

  my %h; $h{a}{b}++;              perl 1   PCL undef      SILENT WRONG
  my %h; $h{a}{b}++; exists $h{a} perl 1   PCL 1          (the OUTER key IS made)
  my %g; $g{x}{y}++; $g{x}{y}++;  perl 2   PCL undef      every ++ lost
  my $r; $r->{p}{q}++;            perl 1   PCL undef
  my @a; $a[0]{k}++;              perl 1   PCL CRASH ("nil is not of type hash-table")
  my %d; $d{m}{n} = 5; $d{m}{n}++ perl 6   PCL 6          (intermediate ALREADY there)

`$h{$a}{$b}++` is THE counting idiom, so this is a wrong ANSWER in one of
the most common shapes in real Perl â and it is silent: the outer key is
created, so `exists`, `keys` and a later `=` all look right.

THE CAUSE IS THREE LINES, `cl/pcl-runtime.lisp` `p-gethash-box` (~9363):

    (let* ((h (unbox hash)) (k (to-string key)))
      ;; If hash is undef, cant get box from it
      (when (eq h *p-undef*)
        (return-from p-gethash-box (make-p-box *p-undef*)))

The emission for a nested `++` is
`(p-post++ (p-gethash-box (p-gethash-box %h "a") "b"))`: the inner call
creates key "a" with an UNDEF box and returns it, and the outer call is then
handed that undef box â a place it could vivify into â and instead returns a
FRESH DETACHED box.  `p-post++` increments a box nobody can reach.  This is
rule 12 exactly: a missing case falling through to a default that produces a
VALUE the program then consumes.

THE FIX SHAPE: this accessor is documented as the EAGER lvalue one ("perls
lvalue autovivification"; `p-gethash-argbox` is the lazy sibling for
read-only uses), so when `hash` is a p-box holding undef it must vivify â
`p-ensure-hashref` (the very next defun) already does precisely that, and
`p-aref-box` needs the array-shaped twin (`p-ensure-arrayref`) for the
`$a[0]{k}++` crash.  Do NOT vivify when the argument is not a writable
place (a raw *p-undef* value), and keep `p-gethash-argbox` untouched â that
is what makes a read not create the key.

RELATED, filed the same session: #1057, the coercing compound assigns
(`.=`, `+=`) over a nested element, which lower through the plain READ
accessor `p-gethash` and CRASH.  The two are the same family seen from two
accessors, and a fix should look at both.

BAR: this is a RUNTIME change, so the full sweep is not optional and
corpus-diff cannot see it; probes must cover the read side (`exists` /
`keys` / a plain read of `$h{a}{b}` must NOT create anything), the deref-root
spellings, and the array intermediate.
=== DONE (s470bk) ===
FIXED, own commit, runtime-only.  `p-gethash-box` and `p-aref-box` â the two
EAGER lvalue accessors, and the only two (ExprToCL emits them for l-value
position only) â vivify an undef CONTAINER when it is a WRITABLE PLACE
(`(p-box-p container)`), through the existing `p-ensure-hashref` /
`p-ensure-arrayref`.  A raw (unwritable) undef keeps the detached box, which is
what stops a read path routed here from creating structure.

NIL JOINS `*p-undef*` in that test, and that is why `$a[0]{k}++` CRASHED rather
than merely losing the write: `%p-elem-cell` promotes an array HOLE to a box of
NIL, so the old `(eq h *p-undef*)` guard missed it and NIL reached SBCL's
GETHASH.  One condition, two failure modes.

MEASURED: 30-row matrix, one file per row (scratch/s470bk/p1058/), 3 identical
at the base -> 12 after this -> 23 after #1057.  Nine rows moved here:
`$h{a}{b}++` (1), `++` twice (2), `--` (-1), `$h{a}{b}{c}++`, `\$h{a}{b}` (both
keys created), `$a[0]{k}++`, `$a[0][1]++`, `$h{a}[0]++`, `$r->{p}{q}++`.

Gate 203 files / 6828 -> 6861 rows across the session, always green but the 13
pclxs xs rows.  Guard `Pl/t/autoviv-02.t` (NEW; autoviv-01.t is the gate's
slowest file and was not touched), inverse-verified.

A FIRST ATTEMPT added a forward `declaim (ftype (function (t) t) â¦)` for the
two ensure functions.  DO NOT: they are already declaimed `(function * *)`
8200 lines earlier and the MISMATCH printed an SBCL warning that polluted four
output-CAPTURING gate files (81 rows) while the behaviour was fine.  A forward
reference inside a function body needs no declaim.

RESIDUE, filed: #1150 (perl vivifies the intermediate on a pure READ too â
needs the emission), #1151 (nested plain `=` loses an alias).
subject: SILENT WRONG (pre-existing, runtime): `$h{a}{b}++` on a fresh hash LOSES the increment â p-gethash-box returns a DETACHED box when its container is undef instead of autovivifying
